$description: Source of truth for @furioursus/ui tokens. Edit this, then run `npm run build`. Values like "{color.accent}" point at another token; see docs/tokens.md.

page.description: Page ground: #e8e3e2 xerox paper, #141414 near-black. The light value is paper-light.webp's average colour, so flat fills sit flush on the texture.

surface.description: Panels and cards that need their own fill. Same as page by default; a site may lift it.

ink-2.description: Secondary text that should still read as content, between ink and muted.

muted.description: Dates, captions, footers, dividers. Purple-leaning grey tuned per theme to clear AA.

heading.description: Headline ink: plain near-black or near-white, no hue. Headlines get their weight from contrast, not colour.

accent.description: Hot pink. The interactive colour: nav links, hover, focus rings, accent-color.

link.description: Acid green. Link hover underlines, blockquotes, positive emphasis. Darker olive on paper so it clears AA.

highlight.description: Nav hover and active, search-match highlight. Pink on paper, caution-tape yellow on black: a third interaction colour in dark mode.

border.description: Solid rules and control outlines, derived from ink.

tint.description: Card fills and row hover, derived from ink. Never a new surface colour.

hairline.description: Dashed and dotted rules: hr, table heads, inline code. Fine for rules, not for text.

note.description: Note admonition (Tailwind blue-400). Fails text contrast on the light page; see docs/tokens.md.

tip.description: Tip admonition (Tailwind lime-500). Fails text contrast on the light page.

important.description: Important admonition (Tailwind purple-400). Fails text contrast on the light page.

caution.description: Caution admonition (Tailwind orange-400). Fails text contrast on the light page.

warning.description: Warning admonition and draft labels (Tailwind red-500). Large text only on the light page.

mono.value: "MonoLisa", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "Segoe UI Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.description: Everything except headlines. MonoLisa is licensed: each site loads its own files, and the stack falls back to the system mono without them.

display.description: Headlines only, weight 700, at optical size 60. Each site loads the font (it's OFL, so it can be self-hosted anywhere).

code.value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

card-title.description: Card headings, pinned so the page-title scale never drags them along.

tight-1.description: A title pulled close to the line beside it.

tight-6.description: Boxed status padding, block axis (furioursus.dev's now-playing box).

bounce.description: Overshoot for things opening: menus, dialogs. Closing uses a plain ease-in.

paper.description: 500×200 tile with the page colour and grain baked in.

dots.description: One 24×24 dot-grid cell, tiled at texture-dots-size over the paper.

dots-size.description: Dot grid pitch. The SVG is one cell, so this is the spacing, not a scale.
